shop_visit.concern: grinding from the front when braking

findings.title: Front brake pads and rotors
findings.spoken: the front brake pads are worn through to the metal, and that's scored both front rotors
findings.found: The front pads are worn through to the metal backing plate, and that's scored both front rotors. That's the grinding.
findings.why: Metal on metal stops the car worse every mile, and scored rotors can't be resurfaced, so the pads and rotors are replaced together.
findings.can_wait: No: it shouldn't be driven like this.
findings.warranty: Not covered: brakes are a wear item.
findings.cheaper_option: None: with the rotors scored, new pads alone wouldn't stop right.

findings.title: Rear brake pads
findings.spoken: the rear brake pads are getting low, but they have some life left
findings.found: The rear pads are at 4 millimeters; new is 10.
findings.why: They're wearing normally and still have some life left.
findings.can_wait: Yes: fine until the next visit, in the next 3,000 to 5,000 miles.
findings.warranty: Not covered: brakes are a wear item.
findings.cheaper_option: None, and there's no need to do them today.
